agent_id.description: Exact sub-agent identifier from the configured `sub_agents` mapping.

exclude_files_pattern.description: Optional portable regex applied to normalized workspace-relative paths for child discovery only.

include_main_summary.description: Whether to include parent-task summary context.

output_requirements.description: Optional output constraints for single-task mode.

task_description.description: Single-task description for one self-contained objective.

tasks.description: Batch mode: multiple independent tasks for the same sub-agent.

output_requirements.description: Optional output constraints for one sub-task. State success criteria, expected format, concrete deliverables, and verification evidence.

task_description.description: Task description for one independent sub-task. Give a concrete objective, relevant constraints, files or commands, and the evidence or deliverable expected by the parent Agent.
